name: Deploy Amazon Connect with Contact Flow

steps.name: Deploy CloudFormation Stack
steps.run: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name amazon-connect-stack --template-file templates/instance.json --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM

steps.name: Upload Contact Flow
steps.run: aws connect create-contact-flow --instance-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name amazon-connect-stack --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`ConnectInstanceId`].OutputValue' --output text) --name 'SimpleWelcomeFlow' --type 'CONTACT_FLOW' --content file://templates/contact-flow.json --description 'A simple welcome contact flow'
